body:
In [this PR](https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/pull/5803), UBSAN's alignment sanitizer is disabled.

I attempted to address these with a short-term fix (see [this commit](https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/compare/main...amaiorano:DirectXShaderCompiler:fix-ubsan-unaligned-access) and [this Godbolt code](https://godbolt.org/z/MxcKcYnb6)), but unfortunately, the code that makes use of the `CheckedReaderWriter`, such as in `DxilPipelineStateValidation::ReadOrWrite`, was just becoming too gnarly and difficult to read. @llvm-beanz has reimplemented this code in upstream Clang properly, and perhaps at some point, we can back-port that code into DXC.
title: Fix UBSAN alignment failures
